items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: he got to be a Brunus fan and learned to play just like Brunus

ctx.x: A little while he played like Brunus for a certain stage in his life there in Chicago he got to be a Brunus fan and learned to play just like Brunus and that would have been done by ear too. But I remember when he was a kid I knew him when he was 10 years old so he would come down and play any rags that he'd ever heard and he didn't read those I don't think he had the music to them. He played them quite accurately too just a sensational ear that could do those things. But in general the ragtime players it was a…
